question: Should the profile replace selected curated text links with live repository cards served by pinme-web.vercel.app?
rationale: The repository explicitly reserves editorial control to the profile owner and requires a judgment about whether an external image service earns its reliability and privacy cost.

options.title: Keep the text-first profile
options.body: Retain the current concise canonical links and avoid adding the external live-image dependency.

options.title: Trial selected cards
options.body: Accept a narrow card experiment only after verifying rendering, accessibility, privacy, accuracy, and graceful failure behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the text-first profile
recommendation.body: Retain the current concise canonical links and avoid adding the external live-image dependency.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the profile and is the repeated current-history contributor for README presentation and project curation.
